main_text.l: Quarto de reliquis quinq; domicilijs orienta-
libus, quæ decimæ continuo ordine succedunt ad
orientale occu-pant & complent, de singulis illis (inquam)
medij cœli adiungimus, qua additione singularum conficimus
Quinto, loca Ecliptica his congruentia ex
cer-tis latitudinum tabulis, quæ singulis seruiunt ex-
latitudinem loci propositi. At latitudo loci uicissim in tabula, ut uo-
catur rationali, Canones reliquis domicilijs ac-
commodatas demonstrat. In area enim tabulæ ra-
tionalis duo perpetuo numeri distincti occurrunt,

page.notes: The table figures are partly unclear in the scan (the degree signs and the 17 column); the "Q 5" and "anno" at the end are a catchword-like fragment of the line and are kept as printed. Figures in the table lines are set in a column and may be misaligned in the transcription.
